description: Selected government Treasury yields (daily) and BLS inflation, employment and wage series (monthly), with observation dates, units and reuse provenance. Returns the last year of observations unless since is given. For research and education only; not financial advice.

series.description: Comma-separated series ids, e.g. treasury_10y,CUUR0000SA0 (CPI-U); omitted means all. An unknown id returns the list of ids.

since.description: First observation date: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD; default one year before the newest observation

title: Treasury and BLS series
